regions.decision: Existing links are route navigation, not tab panels; the component's tab state model would change navigation semantics.
Inventory-specific record schema and URL serialization do not fit private financial transactions. Existing local filters already handle this workflow.
Existing native controls already expose genuine async/error states. Decorative metal and a save-specific state control would obscure these actions.

regions.decision: The other components are galleries, visual effects, fictional fixtures or unrelated workflows. They do not accept transaction-chart semantics and would add unneeded interaction.
